text:
Assistant A is better. It explains the concept in simpler, customer-friendly language and correctly states that language models are generally trained on large amounts of unlabeled text data, then clarifies what “unlabeled” means. Assistant B is more technical, less accessible for a non-technical audience, and gives a less precise answer by saying language models can be trained using either labeled or unlabeled data without explaining that typical language model pretraining uses unlabeled text.

[[A]]
